messages:
maria (support): FYI from a priority CS case — Acme is seeing long request queueing and 429s when their dedicated pool should autoscale. They report spike at 09:12 UTC and requests sat in queue ~70s before failures.

maria (support): repro steps they gave: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/dedicated/acme/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"ping\"}' -v` repeated 200x from their loadgen.

tim (acme): yep, we hit it at 09:12. Dashboard showed tokens queued and latency jumped, then 429s. No billing alert on our side.

raj (oncall): @maria grabbing logs now. Can you share customer org id?

maria (support): org=acme-prod-42. I pulled the customer-facing trace: `route=dedicated-acme, model=m-deploy-10, status=queued->429`.

ops-bot: deploy-autoscaler v2.3.1 detected spike; scale-request submitted to cluster-controller (req_id=rc-9921).

leo (eng-runtime): I see the scale request then a series of `ImagePullBackOff` on warmpool init containers for that tenant's pod set. Logs: `pod/warm-init-xyz: failed to pull image: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc: failed to fetch token` and repeated `403`. That will stall bringing new pods.

leo (eng-runtime): Also found autoscaler backoff: `scale_controller: attach-handshake delayed (imagepull failures), retry in 30s`. The controller keeps requeuing instead of falling back to reserved capacity.

sasha (eng-platform): interesting — any correlation with the org key rotation we ran at 09:00? There was an auth rotation for image pull service accounts rolled in some regions.

leo (eng-runtime): yes, timestamp aligns. The warmpool agent requests image pull tokens from the registry service using tenant-scoped SA. The SA rotation swapped keys but the registry cache still had old mapping, so token requests returned 403 for that tenant for ~3m until the cache TTL cleared.

maria (support): customer denies any billing hold. Could customer-side policy be blocking egress? They confirmed nothing changed.

raj (oncall): from control plane audit, I can see a short-lived billing flag flip for acme-prod-42 at 09:11 — `billing_hold: true` set by billing-service when their payment syscall timed out during rotation. It self-cleared at 09:15. That might have triggered extra checks on image registry calls. Putting both together explains a 4-minute window of failures.

tim (acme): we did have an invoice webhook delay at ~09:10 — bank was slow. We didn't intentionally block anything.

leo (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: SA rotation caused registry token mismatches and a transient billing flag created a permission guard that made registry return 403 instead of 401, so autoscaler retries and warmpool cannot populate. Because minReplica floor was set to 2 and reserved burst had no warm instances available, the system queued requests until the warmpool recovered. Autoscaler also hit a scale-up hysteresis bug where `attach_backoff` didn't escalate priority when imagepull error seen repeatedly.

sasha (eng-platform): that hysteresis bug is a known edge-case in v2.3.1 — we planned a fix in v2.3.2 to treat `ImagePullBackOff` as an immediate priority escalator for tenant-attached scale requests.

maria (support): mitigation steps taken for customer: manual bump of minReplica to 4 at 09:19 to force pod creation, cleared registry cache and restarted warmpool-agent for the acme shard at 09:22. Customer reported queues draining by 09:24.

raj (oncall): documented short mitigations: `kubectl -n acme-prod set resources` not ideal for customers though. We should avoid manual fixes.

leo (eng-runtime): recommended short-term patch: change autoscaler config to treat repeated `ImagePullBackOff` for >30s as escalatable (PR ready), and make warmpool-agent tolerant to token 403s by attempting a refresh against alt-token path.

sasha (eng-platform): long-term: bake in an automatic fallback path — if warmpool cannot populate within Xs, try cold-provision path with pre-warmed minimal image (smaller footprint) to avoid the queue spike. Also link billing-service to registry checks to avoid permission gating during transient billing-webhook delays.

maria (support): customer-facing notes to include in CS follow-up: explain transient key rotation + billing webhook latency, apologize for impact, list actions we did (manual minReplica bump, cache flush), provide ETA for platform fix (v2.3.2 next week), and offer a temporary config knob to set `minReplicaSafety=0` to allow aggressive scale-from-zero for critical customers.

leo (eng-runtime): logs snippet for reference:
```
scale_controller: request rc-9921 submitted
warm-init-abc: pulling image -> token request -> registry 403 (token_mismatch)
scale_controller: backoff 30s (reason=ImagePullBackOff)
```

raj (oncall): followups: 1) sasha/leo coordinate patch for v2.3.2, 2) ops add diagnostic to surface `imagepull: 403` as a first-class cause in customer incidents, 3) CS follow up with Acme with timeline and compensation if warranted.

sasha (eng-platform): I'll own the patch release notes and the fallback gating change. leo, can you open the PR and include a regression test that simulates registry 403 during SA rotation?

leo (eng-runtime): on it, will attach a small e2e that flips registry auth mid-run.

maria (support): thanks everyone — closing as triaged. I'll ping when CS reply goes out. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident-created id=INC-2026-411; severity=medium; owner=maria (support)
